caption:
📚 Hard vocab word #110: DISPARATE

disparate (adjective): fundamentally different; hard to compare.

✅ In a sentence: The exhibit brought together disparate styles, from ancient pottery to digital art.
✅ Similar: dissimilar, contrasting, divergent
✅ Remember it: Noun: disparity (a gap).
